about_the_game:
Tower of Tears is a non-linear Survival-Horror game with 3D Metroidvania elements, an invitation to peek at a foreboding poetic world populated by ambiguous cute characters and subtly disturbing beings. 

The Tower is a dark and unforgiving world to explore, packed with verticality, interconnected places and hidden routes. All locations are seamlessly linked making for an immersive world to decipher...

You play as TEAR, the latest Tower Keeper, weak, fragile, but clever.
You know nothing about your role inside this imposing Tower structure.
The Keeper's Tool, will help you in different ways to fight, explore, traverse or unlock new sections of that somber place. 

Across its damp corridors, you will meet various families, each with roles, shapes, and desires of their own.
You can already hear the cries of those not yet born and those who have lingered far too long… 
And somewhere deep within… MOTHER is calling.

                                                  [FEATURES]

  • Around 5 hours of play-time and more to uncover all of the secrets

  • A unique blend of Survival-Horror and Metroidvania

  • Smooth and Tight Movement : jump, run, lift objects, swim, fly...

  • 15+ Keeper's Tool to experiment with, all with multiple use-cases

  • A lot of Character Upgrades

  • 10+ MP3 files to collect for the in-game immersive MP3 player

  • 10+ Masks to personalize your play-style, all with special abilities

  • Interconnected Areas, featuring unique atmospheres

  • Meet 40+ Unique Ambiguous Monsters and Cute Characters

  • An Immersive Metro System to travel across the Tower

  • Advanced 3D Map System

  • Up to 3 Companion NPCs who can follow you and give bonuse...if they survive

  • Full Game-Pad Support

  • Optimized for Low-Specs PC and Steam Deck

content_descriptors.notes: Presence of disturbing imagery, body horror and death scenes.
